messages:
ali: Noticed an odd discrepancy on the latency panel: /api/v1/predict p95 is steady but p99 jumps only for tenant=internal-dev. p50/p95 look unchanged. anyone else seeing tenant-scoped tails?

rhea: I pulled raw samples. tenant=internal-dev has a tiny sample_count (~7) but several >2s outliers. merged rollup shows p99=2.1s which drags the global p99 up.

sanjay: do we include tenant in rollup key? I thought tenants were in the metadata but we intentionally aggregate across tenants for the default console view.

ops-bot: Deploy note: routing policy change "tenant-sampling-v2" enabled for 25% traffic at 2026-03-21T16:04Z (canary).

rhea: quick query I ran: ```sql
SELECT tenant, percentile(latency_ms,50) p50, percentile(latency_ms,95) p95, percentile(latency_ms,99) p99, count(*)
FROM telemetry_latency
WHERE route='/api/v1/predict' AND region='us-east' AND time>now()-interval '45 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant
ORDER BY p99 DESC;
```

ali: output: tenant=internal-dev count=7 p99=2100 p95=130; tenant=partner_x count=420 p99=140 p95=120. Merging these gives a misleading global p99.

sanjay: sounds like we need two things: (1) UI should show sample counts next to quantiles and a small "split by tenant" control, (2) add a merge-guard to avoid letting tiny high-tail slices dominate global p99 without a clear badge.

rhea: agree. also we should add a note in the console explaining that default "global" rollup may hide slice variance and encourage splitting by tenant/model_variant for troubleshooting.

ali: short-term mitigation: can we surface a tiny badge on the latency card: "split slices: tenant (N) | model_variant (M)" with pencil icon to open split menu? UX can be simple.

sanjay: I'll open RT-4707 for the UI badge + split-by control and add an alert rule: only fire p99 alerts if sample_count >= 20 for the slice or if small-count p99 > baseline * X AND flagged by a human. avoids chasing 1-offs.

ops-bot: Feature request noted: RT-4707 created by sanjay.

ali: thanks. also adding a runbook line: when p99 diverges from p95 and sample_count < 20, check for tiny tenant slices before escalating.

rhea: toggling canary flag off for tenant-sampling-v2 in case it changed sample distributions for internal-dev.

ops-bot: Feature-flag change: tenant-sampling-v2 -> OFF for canary cohort at 16:12 UTC per rhea.

ali: will re-query in 10m and post results. thanks all. :thumbsup:
